title: Lulu and her chick: a new look
kaylee: Lulu the loon and her chick look like they belong on Maple's team now: smooth and round, the team's big shiny eyes, a real loon's checks and necklace, and a fluffy baby.

pictures.title: Lulu
pictures.caption: Same colors and size. New: sculpted shapes, the team's eyes with a thin ruby rim, a long bill that opens in two halves, painted checks, a necklace you can see, feather tips, a flick of feathers on her head.

pictures.title: Her chick
pictures.caption: No more white goggle eyes: fluffy cheeks, a pale chin, a curl of down, stubby wings.
